title: Data failure and backfill lab
description: Inject one failure, choose a recovery depth, and inspect which layers must be repaired before publication resumes.

failures.label: Schema drift
failures.detail: A producer changes a field type or meaning.
failures.blast: All consumers of the changed feature
failures.skew: High if one path accepts a default while another rejects
recovery: Map or version the schema contract

failures.label: Source delay
failures.detail: Events arrive after the expected watermark.
failures.skew: Moderate while online values lag the offline correction
recovery: Confirm source delay with event versus ingestion time
Advance only safe watermarks or use a fallback
Verify freshness before restoring the feature

failures.label: Duplicate events
failures.detail: A retry or producer bug re-emits the same action.
failures.blast: Aggregates keyed by the duplicated event
failures.skew: High if online state increments twice but training is deduplicated
recovery: Enable or repair idempotent event keys
Compare deduplicated offline and online values

failures.label: Bad feature logic
failures.detail: A versioned transform uses the wrong window, default, or join.
failures.blast: Every model consuming that feature version
failures.skew: Critical when only one runtime received the faulty logic
recovery: Stop promotion of the faulty version
Rebuild online materialization and validate parity

strategies.label: Contain and serve fallback
strategies.detail: Protect new decisions first; defer correction.

strategies.label: Bounded event-time backfill
strategies.detail: Rebuild only the known bad interval into a candidate version.

strategies.label: Full replay
strategies.detail: Recompute history when logic or source semantics changed broadly.
